common:
Use case: ui-mockup. MovieAgent is a Windows LOCAL single-user filmmaking/short-drama desktop application. Produce ONE polished complete desktop app screen, 1600x1100 landscape, edge-to-edge UI, no device/browser chrome, no external caption, no collage. Chinese interface; current date anchor 2026-11-02 only when dates are necessary. Screen data fictional. This is a RADICAL REBUILD, not reskinning the old dark green boxed dashboard.
ART DIRECTION "白昼片场 / DAYLIGHT ATELIER": A refined cinema atelier with the editorial sophistication, scenic imagery, expressive composition and airy confident navigation in the supplied user moodboard. Primary family: premium editorial product theater. Warm porcelain #F5F3EC, ink #182733, clear cobalt #2458C6, soft powder blue #E4ECF6, tiny vermilion #DE6445 for attention. Real lightly grained paper and beautiful cinematic photographic assets, NO gradients-as-artwork. Light, cultivated, physical, art-directed; no futuristic sci-fi UI. Custom lowercase "movieagent" wordmark with small flat cobalt aperture symbol. Body Chinese sans 15-16px, supporting mono numbers, elegant light editorial display Chinese serif only on sparse page titles. Thin fine rules, mostly open surface, radius10-16 for media, pill radius only for navigation/buttons. No repeated bento boxes, no cards inside cards, no green glows, no colored outline on every panel, no giant rounded sidebar, no oversized shadows.
SHARED NAVIGATION ON WORKSPACE PAGES: at x40 y28 wordmark; centered small floating PORCELAIN horizontal capsule, slim hairline border and soft short shadow, labels exactly "项目  创作  制作  素材  成片", active has cobalt fill white text and a small white pointer dot. Top right compact search icon, "任务 2" and settings gear. NO vertical application sidebar. Below the header a slim contextual breadcrumb row "雨夜来信 / 第 02 集", scope-switch chevrons; show local section tabs appropriate to the requested page. Do not put all 18 page names in navigation. App shell breathes, content hierarchy derives from real workflow. Navigation could morph between workspaces; the image represents a crisp settled state, never blurred motion.
IMAGERY LANGUAGE: original art-directed fictional cinematic stills. Project "雨夜来信": East Asian young woman Lin Wan, black shoulder-length hair, ivory cotton blouse with navy overcoat, a cream envelope, rainy harbor old town, gray-blue sea, red lighthouse, overcast early daylight. Intentional film grain, real photographic composition. Other projects may use a sunlit desert bus and an architectural blue coast. No generic smiling stock avatars or AI robots. Images have a functional role, not decoration behind form text.
Use the attached moodboard as visual inspiration ONLY; ignore its phone status bar, social overlays and embedded brand names. If an additional generated reference is supplied, follow its branding, nav, colors and typography across screens, adapt layout to this specific workflow. Do NOT repeat its hero on every page. Ensure readable full-screen functional UI rather than a marketing landing page. No invented cloud sync, team collaboration, analytics revenue, unlimited tracks, autonomous one-click film generation or fake AI quality scores. Tiny "概念设计 · 示例内容" at bottom. Screens may rearrange existing functions into new tabs/drawers; do not claim implemented.
